name: Saucy Suitors
source:
Piper is a hard-working but down-trodden young woman who works in a food truck in a popular tourist town. One day, she finds unauthorized rival food trucks parked in her spot without permission - and they're manned by a bunch of sexy chefs who all leave a strangely familiar aftertaste! Piper mustard defend her food truck privileges before her bad work performance ketchups to her, and she mayo find true love in the process! Will she relish the experience, or did she put too much sriracha and soy sauce in this dish? Saucy Suitors is an original otome game where you get to date the sexy bishonen personifications of classic table condiments!

[From [url=https://oddlazdo.itch.io/saucy-suitors-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
派珀是一位勤勞卻備受壓榨的年輕女性，在熱門旅遊小鎮經營餐車。某天，她發現，幾輛未經許可的競爭餐車，擅自停到了自己的攤位上，而掌勺的，竟是一群性感廚師，個個都帶著莫名熟悉的「餘味」！派珀可得趕緊守住經營餐車的權利，免得糟糕的業績讓麻煩「番」上門；過程中，她也許還能「醬」遇真愛！她會好好品味這段經歷，還是在這道菜裡，放了太多是拉差辣椒醬與醬油？《Saucy Suitors》是一款原創乙女遊戲，讓你與經典餐桌調味料化身的性感美少年約會！

[摘自[url=https://oddlazdo.itch.io/saucy-suitors-demo]itch.io[/url]]
